verdict.rationale: Floot has a docs page titled 'self-hosting' stating you can export your generated app's code and database and deploy them wherever you like, but this only covers exporting the output application — not self-hosting Floot's actual AI-native build platform, chat interface, or MCP tooling, which remain cloud-only SaaS. missing for 10: evidence of running Floot's core AI builder/editor/MCP server infrastructure on your own infrastructure, any self-hosted deployment guide for the platform itself, independent confirmation of successful self-hosted exports.
